concept.name: Days of the Week
concept.description: The seven named days of the weekly cycle. A discrete named-category concept with no inherent gradient — days are positions in a repeating cycle, not points on a spectrum. Presented on the circular Days of the Week template.
concept.taxonomy_path: Temporal → Cyclical time → Days of the week
concept.notes: ROM-CR-DOW correctly assigned — days of the week are a discrete named cyclical sequence with no gradient. States mode only (no transitions mode for categorical concepts). Monday conventionally placed at top/start of cycle for European cultures.
